hold_text: Live VM timer scripts: scripts/ops/prop_feed_tick.sh (ict-prop-feed + ict-prop-feed@<account>), scripts/ops/prop_executor_tick.sh (ict-prop-executor + ict-prop-executor@<account>), the breakout-login-check reset-feed path and the attention_watch prop_feed probe; the manager merges under the operator's NO-HALT directive 2026-10-09 ("There is no halting.")
why: Closes PI-20261009-72XUJX8U-0002. The prop feed wrote <feed dir>/tripped after 3 consecutive failures, the first feasibility stop, or the 12/day relogin ceiling; while it existed the feed never logged in again and the executor tick exited 0 without running, until a person dispatched reset-feed. Now the feed keeps a backoff state file (<feed dir>/backoff: consecutive_failures, next_attempt_at, reason, flagged): failures 1-2 retry on the next tick, from the 3rd it backs off 5 min doubling to a 2 h cap, a feasibility stop goes to the cap at once (credential logins are never hammered), and the relogin ceiling keeps the feed on the cap for the rest of the UTC day instead of stopping it. ONE red-flag ping on entering the backoff, ONE recovery ping on the next success. A stale tripped marker is removed with a log line. The executor no longer skips because of the feed (it exits 6 harmlessly when the saved session is not accepted). reset-feed now clears the backoff (still only after its own check passes). attention_watch reads the backoff state (flagged >= 2h is BREACHED, an unreadable state is UNKNOWN, no base dir is UNKNOWN). Revert: git revert of the merge commit; a backoff file left behind is ignored by the old code, which would simply start tripping again.
